text:
lina (People Ops): Quick idea  pilot a 'Thank-a-Mentor' micro-recognition where mentees can nominate a mentor for a digital thank-you + optional desk sticker. Objective: boost mentoring culture and capture stories for Spotlight. Need to confirm nomination flow, sticker inventory, and tracking. Thoughts? :seedling:

owen (HRIS): We can add a short nomination form with fields: mentor name, mentee, short reason (max 140 chars), sticker opt-in (yes/no), country. Exports ready in CSV.

maya (Events): Stickers sound great. Keep sticker batch to 40 for pilot. If US-only shipping we avoid customs. I can source a 3-5 day turnaround vendor.

sam (Finance): Estimate: $2 per digital acknowledgement + $6 per sticker shipped. Pilot of 40 stickers ~= $240. Fine with me; tag me for the PO.

courier-bot: reminder set: "Export Thank-a-Mentor CSV" on 2233334485. :robot_face:

lina (People Ops): Action items: Owen  prototype form + CSV export by Thu. Maya  vendor quote and lead time. Sam  PO approval for up to $300. We'll run nominations for 3 weeks and announce winners in the monthly Town Hall.

owen (HRIS): Will post form link once ready and include manager notification option to confirm mentor consent.

maya (Events): I'll get quotes and post sample sticker art options.

sam (Finance): Approve provisional PO up to $300 for pilot. Please include invoice to finance@redwood.com.

lina (People Ops): Thanks team  excited to trial this. Will draft announcement copy and host a short Slack thread for stories we can surface in Town Hall. :sparkles:
